summary: Workflow-backed code review — one finder per correctness angle plus one finder covering all cleanup angles, an independent verifier for every distinct (file, line) location across the pooled candidates, then a ranked, capped findings report.

result.target:
— Review the freshly committed Phase 1 (#230) E4-XML-Andockung in the TU-Dresden Diplomarbeit cache-engine (C++23, g++-16). Repo roots: super = /home/comdare/Projekte/Research/probst-diplomarbeit-cache-engine ; ce = super/Code/external/comdare-cache-engine. Scope = exactly the last commit on each: ce HEAD 698977fe "run_profile Produktiv-Fassade" and super HEAD 5b5dc9c "super-Andockung + ce-Bump". Review these diffs (use `git -C <root> show <sha>` / `git -C <root> diff <sha>^ <sha>`):
(1) NEW ce libs/cache_engine/builder/profile_facade/{profile_run_facade.hpp, profile_run_facade.cpp, CMakeLists.txt} — a GoF Facade that isolates the umbrella-heavy tlz::run_profile (tests/unit/thesis_tiere/profile_run_entry.hpp) behind a POD-only header so super/Code/02_messung_driver/main.cpp can call it without pulling all_axes_umbrella (19 axis types compile-time).
(2) ce CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR -> PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR in libs/cache_engine/builder/anatomy_module_loader/CMakeLists.txt + libs/cache_engine/builder/workload_driver/CMakeLists.txt (claimed No-Op in standalone ce, needed for super sub-build include paths).
(3) super Code/02_messung_driver/{main.cpp (+75, guarded opt-in E4-XML dock via COMDARE_RUN_E4_XML), CMakeLists.txt (+21, if(TARGET comdare::profile_run_facade))}.
Focus on: correctness of the facade wiring (ProfileRunArgs->tlz::RunProfileArgs field mapping incl. RunProfileResult any_measured/any_resumed, the g++-16 @rsp CompileFn with response-file + mess-defines COMDARE_MEASUREMENT_ON/EXPERIMENT_MODE_ON, std::system call safety), the CMake changes (PUBLIC vs PRIVATE include isolation, EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL, the COMDARE_PAPER_CODEGEN_CONSUMER_TARGETS codegen-ordering property, COMDARE_FACADE_PERM_INCLUDES '|'-join), and the main.cpp guard/opt-in/fallback logic. HARD REQUIREMENTS the change claims to honor — flag any violation: additive only, golden/ABI-neutral (must NOT touch permutation_axes.xml / golden_fullpilot_320 / ABI-MAJOR / POD sizeof / GenusBindingTraits), no runtime-switch/vtable in hot path (String->Type stays compile-time behind the .cpp), no Python in the build chain. Also check for resource/lifetime bugs, path-injection in the @rsp/std::system command, and any case where the opt-in dock could break the classic ExperimentDriver fallback path.
result.summary: This review covers the Phase-1 docking of an XML-profile-driven E4 measurement facade (the ce `profile_run_facade` library plus the super `messung_driver` E4 dock), a change the author has since reverted for CI failure. The most severe issues are that the facade does not compile in the super sub-build at all (its CMake omits the vendored allocator/paper adapter include dirs pulled transitively by the axis umbrella, [8]) and that the new E4 dock is a far thinner wrapper than the `run_lazy_150` harness it succeeds — it drops top-level exception handling, the "0 valid profiles" hard abort, RAM admission, platform/build CSV tagging, cap-parse validation, and the SOTA opt-out — so an opt-in multi-day thesis run can silently emit scientifically-invalid or platform-mislabeled data, blow past its intended build cap, OOM, or abort past the fallback it explicitly promises to preserve. The remaining findings are lower-confidence, config-dependent build/robustness edge cases and copy-paste/altitude cleanups in the facade's CMake and its hand-rolled g++ compile-fn.

findings.summary: The facade's PRIVATE link/include set omits the ~15 vendored allocator/paper adapter targets (comdare::adapter::a04_mimalloc..a11, p07..p30) whose usage-requirement include dirs supply <mimalloc.h> and the other vendored headers that all_axes_umbrella transitively #includes, so the facade's own umbrella TU fails to compile in the super sub-build.
findings.failure_scenario: In the super build messung_driver links comdare::profile_run_facade, so the facade compiles profile_run_facade.cpp -> profile_run_entry.hpp -> source_catalog.hpp -> all_axes_umbrella.hpp -> axis_06_allocator_registry -> axis_06_allocator_mimalloc -> <mimalloc.h>. Because target_link_libraries lists only Boost::mp11 + xml_config_parser + workload_driver + anatomy_module_loader (not the a04_mimalloc..a11 / p07..p30 adapter targets that carry the vendored include dirs, the way test_v31_adapters at tests/unit/CMakeLists.txt:277-301 does), g++ errors 'mimalloc.h: No such file or directory' and the analyse:thesis-data super-CI job goes red (this exact failure is documented in the later super revert fac49e66). Standalone-ce hid it because the facade is EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL and was only ever built via an explicit --target where those adapter include dirs happened to be present globally, and the smoke targets it claims parity with (m3v2_pmc_smoke) only compile the umbrella under a config where the codegen-gated allocator path is inactive.

findings.summary: The Achse-2 'COMDARE_LOAD_PROFILE_DIR set but 0 valid profiles -> hard abort' guard (run_lazy_150.cpp:201-205, 'Achse 2 darf nicht still entfallen') is dropped, even though line 129 claims parity with run_lazy_150.cpp:193-206 which contains that guard. [same root cause also at: /home/comdare/Projekte/Research/probst-diplomarbeit-cache-engine/Code/external/comdare-cache-engine/libs/cache_engine/builder/profile_facade/profile_run_facade.cpp:132]
findings.failure_scenario: Operator launches the opt-in multi-day E4 run (COMDARE_RUN_E4_XML=1) with COMDARE_LOAD_PROFILE_DIR pointing at a mistyped/wrong dir, or one whose XMLs all fail parse_load_profile's strict <op_mix> validation. The harness would abort immediately (exit 4). The facade silently proceeds with an empty workload_registry; run_profile then skips the workload-axis injection (profile_run_entry.hpp:132), so every emitted CSV row goes through the fixed-workload run_observable_perm fallback with two_phase_valid=0 -- the entire multi-day measurement is scientifically invalid and this is only discovered after it finishes.

findings.summary: An uncaught exception in the opt-in E4 block (throwing std::filesystem::create_directories(e4_dir) at 496 and the entirely unguarded run_profile_facade(pa) at 512) unwinds main and skips the classic ExperimentDriver fallback the comment promises always runs. [same root cause also at: /home/comdare/Projekte/Research/probst-diplomarbeit-cache-engine/Code/02_messung_driver/main.cpp:490, /home/comdare/Projekte/Research/probst-diplomarbeit-cache-engine/Code/02_messung_driver/main.cpp:512, /home/comdare/Projekte/Research/probst-diplomarbeit-cache-engine/Code/02_messung_driver/main.cpp:512, /home/comdare/Projekte/Research/probst-diplomarbeit-cache-engine/Code/02_messung_driver/main.cpp:512]
findings.failure_scenario: With COMDARE_RUN_E4_XML=1 and a valid profile, if e4_dir cannot be created (output_dir on a read-only mount, or a path component is a regular file) create_directories(e4_dir) at line 496 uses the THROWING overload and throws std::filesystem::filesystem_error; it is uncaught, so main() aborts via std::terminate and the classic ExperimentDriver A/B/C measurement path (documented 'laeuft dennoch weiter (additiv)') never executes -- the whole messung_driver dies producing no measurements. Same outcome for any throw (std::bad_alloc while building the 320-tree, DLL-load/filesystem errors) escaping run_profile_facade(pa) at line 512, directly contradicting the 'additiv, bricht KEINEN bestehenden Lauf' invariant.

findings.summary: E4 dock compiles/measures on Linux with g++-16 but never sets ProfileRunArgs::platform_override, so run_profile stamps every CSV row with the profile's platform="win-x86_64" (m3v2_study.profile.xml:145 -> profile_run_entry.hpp:144-149,201). [same root cause also at: /home/comdare/Projekte/Research/probst-diplomarbeit-cache-engine/Code/02_messung_driver/main.cpp:508]
findings.failure_scenario: Operator runs COMDARE_RUN_E4_XML=1 on Linux (prod1) with the default m3v2_study profile: output_dir/e4_xml_profile/measurements.csv rows all carry platform=win-x86_64 even though every perm_<id>.so was built and measured by g++-16 on Linux, silently mis-attributing Linux/g++ measurements to Windows in the primary thesis dataset (platform dimension corrupted, no error surfaced).

findings.summary: The E4 dock never sets pa.min_free_gb and exposes no env/arg to enable RAM admission; the successor to run_lazy_150 (which took min_free_gb via argv[7]) hardcodes the default 0.0 (admission OFF).
findings.failure_scenario: On a memory-constrained cluster node the E4 dock runs ~4 parallel g++-16 umbrella compiles (all 19 axis types, multi-GB each) with RAM admission disabled and no way to turn it on. Free RAM is exhausted, the OOM-killer terminates a g++ or messung_driver itself, aborting or corrupting the multi-day run -- exactly the failure the harness let operators gate via min_free_gb.

findings.summary: std::strtoull for COMDARE_E4_CAP is used with no endptr/errno validation and can silently produce 0 or a truncated value.
findings.failure_scenario: An operator sets COMDARE_E4_CAP to a malformed value ('auto', '1k', a typo) intending to cap the build; strtoull returns 0, so pa.max_binaries=0 silently means 'use the profile's full <run_options>.cap' and the driver builds far more tier binaries than intended (a multi-day build kicked off unbounded). An out-of-range value yields ULLONG_MAX with errno=ERANGE ignored, and on a 32-bit-size_t target (RISC-V build in the platform matrix) the unsigned-long-long result narrows/truncates into std::size_t max_binaries.

findings.summary: The E4 dock never sets pa.run_sota_series and provides no COMDARE_RUN_SOTA opt-out; the harness honored env COMDARE_RUN_SOTA=0 (run_lazy_150.cpp:269-270) to disable the SOTA-series passes, so the dock always runs them.
findings.failure_scenario: An operator wanting a basis-only (re)measurement has no way to skip the SOTA-series passes; the E4 dock always builds and measures every declared <sota_series> tier, adding unrequested multi-day compute (and rebuilding SOTA binaries) to a run that only needed the basis-320 subset.

findings.summary: COMDARE_FACADE_PERM_INCLUDES only appends Boost.MP11 when the vendored tree exists, so a FetchContent-provided mp11 is silently dropped from the self-contained perm sub-compile include set.
findings.failure_scenario: On a machine/config where the vendored cmake/third_party/boost_mp11 directory is absent and Boost.MP11 is instead resolved via FetchContent (the documented fallback in cmake/boost_mp11_setup.cmake, whose real include dir is ${boost_mp11_SOURCE_DIR}/include, not under cmake/third_party), the if(EXISTS "${_facade_mp11_inc}/boost/mp11.hpp") guard at line 91 is false. The baked COMDARE_FACADE_PERM_INCLUDES then omits any mp11 include dir. At runtime, with COMDARE_RUN_E4_XML=1 and COMDARE_PILOT_INCLUDES unset, perm_include_dirs() returns that mp11-less list, so every emitted perm_<id>.cpp (which pulls all_axes_umbrella -> boost/mp11) fails the g++-16 @rsp sub-compile with 'boost/mp11.hpp: No such file or directory'. run_profile builds zero tier DLLs and returns exit_code=1 with no measurements, even though the facade lib itself linked fine (it links Boost::mp11 directly, masking the gap in the separate perm sub-compile).

findings.summary: perm_include_dirs() resolves the g++ include set through the global env COMDARE_PILOT_INCLUDES in preference to the facade's own CMake-baked COMDARE_FACADE_PERM_INCLUDES, so a stale/foreign value in the environment silently replaces the correct include set (wrapper routing through a global instead of its own state).
findings.failure_scenario: The measurement host or a leftover thesis_tiere shell exports COMDARE_PILOT_INCLUDES with Windows/cl-style or otherwise mismatched ';'-separated paths (the header comment states the infra host sets this per platform); the facade ignores its correct baked includes (incl. vendored boost/mp11) and hands those to g++-16, so every perm_<id>.cpp @rsp compile fails with 'boost/mp11: No such file', zero binaries build, measurements.csv is header-only and run returns exit_code=1.

findings.summary: The g++ shell command is assembled by string concatenation with only double-quote wrapping of the response-file and log paths (both derived from the configured measurement output directory), so shell metacharacters in that path break or inject into the invocation.
findings.failure_scenario: If the measurement output directory contains a double quote, $, or backtick (e.g. an operator points output at a path like /data/run"1 or one containing $(...)), the constructed command `g++-16 @"..." > "..." 2>&1` passed to std::system is mis-tokenized by /bin/sh: every perm build fails (zero usable tier binaries for the whole E4 run), or an embedded $(cmd)/backtick executes an arbitrary command during the measurement. Double-quote wrapping guards spaces but not these metacharacters.

findings.summary: COMDARE_RUN_E4_XML is compared exactly against the string "1", so common truthy spellings and trailing whitespace leave the opt-in inactive.
findings.failure_scenario: An operator or CI sets COMDARE_RUN_E4_XML to 'true', 'yes', or '1\n'/'1 ' (a trailing newline/space when sourced from a file); std::string_view{e4_flag} == "1" is false, so want_e4 stays false and the E4-XML #229 measurement silently never starts -- only the classic ExperimentDriver path runs, with just an 'INAKTIV' log line and no indication the intended run was skipped.

findings.summary: std::system's POSIX return value is an encoded wait-status, not the process exit code, but is returned raw as the CompileFn result and then rendered downstream as the compile exit code.
findings.failure_scenario: On the target Linux/g++-16 platform, a perm_<id>.cpp that fails to compile with exit code 1 makes std::system return 256 (1<<8); build_orchestrator.hpp:310 stores that in BuildResult.status and logs message 'compile-exit 256' (a g++ ICE killed by SIGSEGV -- a known transient on this project -- shows as ~35584). Anyone triaging a failed tier binary sees a meaningless encoded number instead of the real exit code 1, and any tooling that keys on specific compile exit codes misfires. (The status==0 success/failure test itself stays correct because raw 0 iff the child exited 0.)

findings.summary: make_gpp_compile_fn re-implements the response-file (@rsp) compile-fn pattern that already exists as build_orchestrator.hpp make_system_compile_fn and is copy-pasted in run_lazy_150.cpp/test_sota_series_pilot.cpp/test_axis_sweep_pilot.cpp. [same root cause also at: /home/comdare/Projekte/Research/probst-diplomarbeit-cache-engine/Code/external/comdare-cache-engine/libs/cache_engine/builder/profile_facade/profile_run_facade.cpp:119]
findings.failure_scenario: build_orchestrator.hpp:353 already hosts make_system_compile_fn as the designated CompileFn factory (MSVC variant), and the identical @rsp+std::system+.log structure is duplicated in run_lazy_150.cpp:234-249 and two thesis_tiere pilots. Now a 4th+ copy exists. Any fix to the shared logic (rsp quoting, added mess-define, diagnostics flag, exit-status handling) must be replicated in every copy or they silently diverge; the correct home is a make_gpp_compile_fn factory in build_orchestrator that the facade and harness share.

findings.summary: The production facade library reaches into the test tree: it adds ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/thesis_tiere to its PRIVATE include set and bakes it into COMDARE_FACADE_PERM_INCLUDES.
findings.failure_scenario: A 'produktive Fassade' and every emitted perm.cpp sub-compile depend on headers under tests/unit/thesis_tiere (profile_run_entry.hpp/source_catalog.hpp/sota_catalog.hpp). If that test directory is ever relocated, pruned, or excluded from a packaging/install/non-test build, both the facade TU and every E4 perm.cpp @rsp compile fail with C1083. The library->tests dependency direction is an altitude smell (acknowledged Phase-1 debt in the header comment, to be lifted into a production location later).

findings.summary: The super-sub-build -I fix (CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR -> PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR) is applied only to workload_driver + anatomy_module_loader; sibling builder modules pruef_dock and anatomy_codegen_tool still use CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR.
findings.failure_scenario: This is a general defect (CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR is the super root in an add_subdirectory sub-build) patched at two instances rather than generalized. libs/cache_engine/builder/pruef_dock/CMakeLists.txt:11-13 and anatomy_codegen_tool/CMakeLists.txt:10-22 still hard-code ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/cache_engine/... in their PUBLIC include dirs. The next super-sub-build consumer that links either module gets -I pointing at <super-root>/libs/cache_engine (nonexistent) -> C1083/'No such file' on its public headers. A shared helper/variable for the ce include root would fix the class, not two symptoms.

refuted.summary: COMDARE_RUN_E4_XML=1 runs the facade E4 chain but then falls through (no return/skip) into the full classic ExperimentDriver A/B/C path; there is no E4-only mode.

COMDARE_FACADE_PERM_INCLUDES (the -I set baked for the RUNTIME g++ @rsp compile of every emitted perm_<id>.cpp) is derived solely from the same incomplete _facade_heavy_includes (+mp11) and therefore also lacks the vendored adapter include dirs, so the actual E4 tier-binary builds cannot find <mimalloc.h>; fixing the link libraries (finding at line 72) does NOT populate this baked path, so it is a second, independent break.
